Commentary.Commentary: Right then that is all we have from this game. Action in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier B continues on Thursday, the 14th of July where Zimbabwe will take on USA and Jersey face Singapore. Both matches will begin at 5 pm IST (11.30 am GMT) but as you all know our build-up will begin much sooner. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Sean Williams wins the MAN OF THE MATCH award for his exceptional effort with the blade. He says that it is awesome to be back with the side. Mentions he is glad that he has a great team around to support him and it would've difficult to win these trophies without their help. Adds they have great set of players and always aim to win every game. Adds they will take it one game at a time and hopefully it works in their favour.

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe says it is always nice to win 2 from 2 and credits the Jersey bowlers for bowling well. Confirms that the wicket was slower and gives credit to Luke for pushing them to a decent total. Says the team is prepared for the last game against a good team

Charles Perchard the skipper of Jersey is in for a chat. He says that they showed great fight in 20 overs. Adds he backed the team to chase it down. Says the boy are gutted. Further says the plan was to attack the spinners, but that was not the case.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier the Jersey bowlers had done well to restrict Zimbabwe to under 150 but their batters did not follow up that performance. Zimbabwe at the half way stage would have been disappointed with their batting effort. Sean Williams was the only one who looked good and if it was not for Luke Jongwe’s power hitting towards the end, Jersey might've managed to get over the line.

Zimbabwe will be very pleased with their bowlers as they looked unfazed defending this total. Ryan Burl was the pick of the bowlers getting 3 wickets for 13 runs in his 4 overs. All the other bowlers were accurate and never let Jersey get in front of the game.

Jersey started well but lost Nick Greenwood early on. Harrison Carlyon and Asa Tribe chose to preserve their wickets and tried to steady the ship but once Asa Tribe departed they lost wickets in quick succession. Since then the run rate started to creep up and Jersey were not able to push hard in the fag end of the innings. Benjamin Ward came in with intent but it was a little too late. Harrison Carlyon scored 45 runs but could not do the same briskly.

This has been a laboured performance by Jersey. Just as we expected, the quality of Zimbabwe was just a shade too much for Jersey to be able to close this game. Despite setting a low target, Zimbabwe looked in complete control as their bowlers were disciplined and never let Jersey get a move on in this game.
Good length, on off. Julius Sumerauer pushes it to covers. ZIMBABWE WIN THE GAME BY 23 RUNS.
A single now as this is pushed to covers.

BYE! A sharp bouncer, on off. Julius Sumerauer tries to go for the hook shot but misses. The batters scamper for a single. Regis Chakabva throws the ball to Blessing Muzarabani but the latter is unable to disturb the stumps at the non-striker's end.
A yorker length delivery, on middle and leg. Benjamin Ward works it to the leg side and crosses.
BYE! Length, outside off. Julius Sumerauer swings and misses. The keeper fumbles and they collect a bye.
Julius Sumerauer is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Importantly it is a dot ball to start the final over. It is a length ball, wide outside off. Harrison Carlyon looks to chase it with a wild slash. He only manages to get a thick outside edge and Regis Chakabva makes no mistake behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BANG! A slower bouncer, on off. Ward stands tall and smokes it over the square leg fence for a maximum. 28 runs needed off the final over. Can Jersey get over the line here?
FOUR! Benjamin Ward tires to step up here. A low full toss, on middle and leg. Benjamin Ward gets low and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. 8 runs off the over so far.
On a length, around off. Harrison Carlyon pushes it to covers for one.
Length ball, on off. Ward guides it to third man for a single.

Brilliant effort by Tendai Chatara at short fine leg. He saves a boundary for his side, but he seems to have injured himself. He asks the physio to come on who walks him off the ground. It is angled down leg. Carlyon uses his wrists and flicks it to the right of short fine leg. Tendai Chatara makes a sharp stop. They take one.
Full length, on the pads. Ward tucks it square on the leg side for one more.
On a length, around off. Harrison Carlyon pushes it to cover but straight to the fielder.
Length ball, on the pads, Ward tucks it to mid-wicket for one more.
FOUR! Tendai Chatara goes full and on the pads. Ward flicks it through square leg for a boundary.

LEG BYE! Tendai Chatara fires in a yorker, on the money. Harrison Carlyon stays back and ends up playing all over it. The ball rolls out to the off side off the pads. There is a bit of a confusion but the batters are safe and cross for one.
Full length, on the pads, Benjamin Ward tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A single to start the over. It is a length ball, on off. Harrison Carlyon pushes it to cover for one.
Full and on off. Harrison Carlyon pushes it to covers for one.

FOUR! Edged but safe. It is tossed up, around off. Harrison Carlyon has a poke at it and finds the outside edge. It runs down to third man for a boundary. Regis Chakabva misses a crucial chance behind the sticks.
Another single as this is worked down to long on.
Full and on leg, Harrison Carlyon flicks it to long on for a single.
FOUR! This should release some pressure. It is short and on off. Harrison Carlyon dances down the track and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. It lands in the gap and goes over the ropes on a bounce.
Flatter one, ourside off. Benjamin Ward eases it to mid off for a single.
Two dots in a row to end the over. It is on a length, outside off. Harrison Carlyon is unable to hit it. 62 runs needed in 24 balls.

Swing and a miss! This is close to the off stump. It is angled in on a length, just outside off. Harrison Carlyon tries to heave it across the line but misses. He is fortunate enough to see the ball sneak past the off pole.
Length ball, on off. Ward uses his feet and helps it to mid on for a single.
Play and a miss! Full length, outside off. Benjamin Ward tries to smash it through the line but misses.
SIX! BOOM! Benjamin Ward gets in his groove. Back of a length, on off. Benjamin Ward swivels and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
It is a short ball, outside off. Ward punches it to mid off.
Change. Blessing Muzarabani is back into the attack.
Milton Shumba serves this full once again outside off, Harrison Carlyon fends this back to the left of the bowler.
Shorter in length and wide outside off, Harrison Carlyon goes on his back foot and cuts this through point for a couple of runs.
Full and angled into the pads, Benjamin Ward works this through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Benjamin Ward gets a hold of this one and finally, Jersey gets a boundary! Full and on off, Benjamin Ward gets on one knee and lifts it to the cow corner fence for a much-needed boundary!
Flights this one full and turning from outside off, Benjamin Ward is beaten all ends up.
Full and outside off, Harrison Carlyon hit this through cover-point for a single.
On off, defended to mid off. Ryan Burl ends his spell with three wickets.
Loopy ball, outside off. Harrison Carlyon drives it to covers for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for one more.
Full and on off, pushed to cover for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ben Stevens gives away his wicket to Zimbabwe, They are losing wickets in quick succession now. It is flighted and full, on off. Stevens charges down the track and lofts it through the line towards long off. Milton Shumba in the deep makes no mistake. Benjamin Ward is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and full, around off. Ben Stevens comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Full and served faster outside off, Harrison Carlyon hits this straight to the cover fielder.
Straying down leg as he angles this from a shorter length. Ben Stevens goes back in his crease and works this to fine leg for a run.
Pulls his length back slightly outside off, Harrison Carlyon strokes this through covers for another single.
Sean Williams continues bowling full and angling it into the stumps, Ben Stevens reverse sweeps once again towards backward point for a run.
This is full outside off, driven towards long off for a single by Harrison Carlyon.
Goes over the wicket to the left-hander and gets this full in line with the stumps, Ben Stevens reverse sweeps it towards deep backward point for a single.
Length and on off, pushed to the off side.
Looped up, around off, blocked out.

OUT! CUAGHT! Ryan Burl gets another one. Zimbabwe are right on top now. It is full and on off. Jonty Jenner lofts it towards long off but is unable to get the desired distance on it. Wellington Masakadza gathers it cleanly in the deep. Ben Stevens is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Another single now as this is driven to covers.
On off, pushed through covers for one more.
On middle and leg. Harrison Carlyon flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full and angling into the pads, Harrison Carlyon flicks this through mid-wicket to take a single and retain strike.
Shorter in length outside off, Jonty Jenner knocks this towards long off for a run.
Full once again and outside off, Jonty Jenner gets this to the cover fielder.
Short once again outside off, Jonty Jenner knocks this towards short third man.

Full outside off, Harrison Carlyon goes to work this leg side and missed. Hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire probably reckons its missing the off stump and the batters get across for a leg bye.
Sean Williams begins with a short delivery on off, Harrison Carlyon goes back in the crease and mistimes it towards cover.
On off, pushed to mid off for a single.
On off, defended to point.
floated and on off, Jonty Jenner pushes it to cover for one.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ryan Burl braks this partnership. It is short and on off. Asa Tribe pulls it to deep mid-wicket where Wesley Madhevere takes a sharp catch. Asa Tribe is unable to take his innings deep this time. Zimbabwe will be aiming to build on this wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Wesley Madhevere b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
On off, blocked out.
This one is flighted full outside off. Asa Tribe does not find the gap past covers.
Full and on the pads, Harrison Carlyon plays this through mid-wicket to keep the scoreboard ticking with a single.
Uses his feet again to a full delivery on middle. Works this towards long on to get off strike.
Streaky runs! Full and fired outside off as Sean Williams sees Asa Tribe come down the wicket. He goes through with the shot and gets a thick outside edge over backward point for a couple of runs.
Full and angled into the pads, Harrison Carlyon gets down the wicket and works it towards long on for one run.
Short and outside off, Harrison Carlyon cuts this late towards the backward point fielder.
On off, pushed to mid off for another single.
Looped up, on off. Tribe eases it to long on for one more.
A single now as this is clipped to square leg.
Touch short, on off. Harrison Carlyon goes for the cut on the back foot but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on off. Tribe pushes it to cover for one.
Flatter and on off. Tribe punches it to covers.
This is straight in line with the stumps and a fraction short. Harrison Carlyon defends this back to the bowler. Just 3 runs from Sean Williams' first over!
Short delivery turning from outside off, Asa Tribe guides this through cover-point for a single.
Full delivery closer to the stumps, Harrison Carlyon works this towards long on for a single.
Short once again outside off, Asa Tribe manages to find the gap through point this time for a single.
Full and outside off, Asa Tribe guides this to the right of backward point and a good stop prevents a single.
Sean Williams serves this short outside off, Asa Tribe gets low and cuts it straight to backward point.
Full and on off. Tribe drives it through covers for a single. Jersey are 41/1 at the end of Powerplay.
This is eased down to long off for a single.
Short and on off. Tribe pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
On off, blocked out.
WIDE! Angled down leg, Tribe misses his flick. Wided.
Quicker and flatter, on off. Harrison Carlyon flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off. Harrison Carlyon hits it down to long off for one.

FOUR! Gets this one away! Blessing Muzarabani goes a fraction full and strays down leg, Asa Tribe has been in good form and does not miss out on this one as he works this through square leg for a boundary! Great timing on this shot!
Blessing Muzarabani continues bowling a good length and straight, Asa Tribe fends this towards mid-wicket.
This one is back of a length and gets a bit of extra bounce. Asa Tribe goes up on his toes and taps it down into the pitch.
Blessing Muzarabani bowls this straight and on a good length. Asa Tribe fends this back to the bowler.

Dropped in the deep! A chance goes begging for Zimbabwe! Blessing Muzarabani pulls his length back and angles it into the batter. Harrison Carlyon pulls this towards deep square leg where Wellington Masakadza dives forward and makes a mess of it. The batters take a single and Harrison Carlyon will realize he has been really lucky.
Blessing Muzarabani gets this on a good length in line with the stumps. Harrison Carlyon fends this towards mid-wicket.
Good length, outside off. Asa Tribe goes for the punch through the line but misses. 8 runs and a wicket off it.
This is full and angled in on off. Asa Tribe pushes it gently to covers.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
FOUR MORE! Back of a length, outside off. Asa Tribe stands tall and cuts it through point for four more. He is off to a flyer.
FOUR! Tribe is off the mark with a boundary. It is short outside off. Asa Tribe stands back and cuts it through point for a four.
Asa Tribe in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tendai Chatara draws the first blood. It is a short ball, on middle and leg. Nick Greenwood stays inside the crease and pulls it to mid-wicket. Craig Ervine there takes a sharp catch. Early wicket for Zimbabwe, that's what they were after.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Short this time and outside off, Harrison Carlyon cuts this and once again finds the point fielder.

Wellington Masakadza flights this full outside off, Nick Greenwood tries to heave this but gets an outside edge that falls to the left of short third man. The throw is poor as the batters complete a quick single.

FOUR! Nick Greenwood finds the gap here! Wellington Masakadza delivers this full on off, Nick Greenwood sweeps and pierces the gap between fine leg and square leg for a boundary! Good start for Jersey!
WIDE! Fires this one short and down leg, Nick Greenwood tries to play at and misses, as the umpire calls a wide.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Harrison Carlyon works this through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and in line with the stumps, Harrison Carlyon defends this back to the bowler.
Wellington Masakadza begins with a short delivery outside off, Harrison Carlyon slashes at this and finds the point fielder.
Change. Wellington Masakadza comes into the attack now.
Length ball, on the pads. Harrison Carlyon clips it to deep square leg for one more. 8 runs off the over.
Harrison Carlyon now tucks it off his hips towards square leg. The batters take a couple.
Another short delivery, on the bodyline. Nick Greenwood pulls it to mid-wicket for one.
Short again, outside off. Nick Greenwood cuts it hard to point.
FOUR! Nick Greenwood is off the mark in a fine manner. It is a short ball, on the body. Nick Greenwood pulls it to deep square leg for four.
Short ball, outside off. Nick Greenwood looks to chase it but misses.
Blessing Muzarabani to steam in from the other end.
Straighter line on a good length. Harrison Carlyon defends this back to the bowler.
Short and wide once more, Harrison Carlyon can not make use of this as it beats the outside edge of his bat.

FOUR! Harrison Carlyon connects his bat to the delivery beautifully! Tendai Chatara has been far too short this over and delivers another one wide from the stumps. Harrison Carlyon smacks this through cover-point for the first boundary of the innings!
Good-length delivery just outside off, Harrison Carlyon fends this towards covers.
Goes even shorter outside off, Harrison Carlyon manages to get this just over point for a couple of runs.
Tendai Chatara begins with a short delivery outside off, Harrison Carlyon strokes this firmly towards point.
